video.script: You take meeting notes but never actually review them. Next week comes, same conversation. You're missing the patterns hiding in your own writing. This tool does one thing: paste your raw 1:1 notes and it surfaces what you stopped noticing. Recurring themes your team keeps bringing up. Followups you forgot you owed. Prompts to open stronger next time. Built for management, not sales calls. Free, runs in your browser. Link in the description.
